title: One PageBuilder for full and partial builds
summary: Full-site and one-page commands call the same PageBuilder pipeline and differ only by selected route set; partial build filters routes before page compilation and updates dependent indexes safely.
invariants: No second parser, renderer, composer or PageBuilder for partial build.
Build modes differ only in route selection.
The selected page output matches full build semantically.
Shared indexes are updated or explicitly reported stale.
